status: entry_rules_saved; awaiting trade-event data approval and an execution-model implementation
user_instruction: Enter immediately at the stretch level. Do not wait for a candle to close or for price to turn back.
target_selection_note: The 15-point target is an inherited research focus, not a newly proven optimum for immediate entry. The earlier 5/10/15-point comparison and its failures remain preserved.

rules.reference: First eligible MNQ trade at or after 09:30:00 Eastern on the cash-session date. Verify it agrees with the saved minute open before comparing studies.
rules.entry_window: From the reference trade through, but excluding, 09:45:00 Eastern.
rules.trigger: First trade reaching or passing O + D signals a short; first trade reaching or passing O - D signals a long. Thresholds remain fixed that day.
rules.entry: Immediate touch model, with no bar-close or pullback condition. The exact trade-level fill model and executable-fill sensitivities must be frozen and tested before new scored results.
rules.exit: 15-point target toward the opening price; stop 20/30/40 points beyond entry for trigger 40/60/80. Exit any remaining position at the 60- or 120-minute deadline measured from the actual modeled fill timestamp.
rules.frequency: One trade per cash session per separately simulated configuration. First trigger locks the side. No re-entry, size escalation, or automatic stop-and-reverse.
rules.chart_interpretation: The attached chart motivates a rapid counter-move. Its unlabeled blue/orange lines do not define an indicator-based entry rule.

costs.note: Inherited research assumptions; not a broker quote or evidence of actual fills.

inherited_criteria.selection: Among eligible configurations, highest net P&L / maximum daily closed-equity drawdown; ties higher net, then lower trigger, then shorter horizon.
inherited_criteria.required_evaluation_scenarios: Baseline, doubled costs, and a tick-scale execution-delay sensitivity to be specified before scoring. The old one-minute delay is inappropriate as the sole stress for the new intrabar hypothesis.
inherited_criteria.progression: First repair data resolution and freeze/verify fill modeling. Stop if no candidate passes development. Request later-period data only if development supports continuing.

prior_evidence.why_finer_data: Feasible one-minute ordering bounds span profits and losses; no intrabar fill sequence is observed.
prior_evidence.confirmed_entry_result: The 79.49% development win rate and its selected 2024 results apply to the old candle-confirmed rule and must not be attributed to immediate touch.
prior_evidence.prior_exposure: Existing minute and descriptive results have been inspected. No historical interval is certified globally unseen; no prospective result exists.

acquisition.development_windows: Only previously eligible development sessions whose minute range reaches at least one 40-point threshold during the entry window; each requested 09:30â€“11:46 Eastern. Select solely on entry reachability, never trade outcome.

acquisition.limitations: Trade events resolve observed price order, not queue position or guaranteed order fills. They do not provide a full quote/order book. Data gaps, event ordering, symbols and bar reconciliation require validation.
acquisition.quote_note: Metadata estimates only; not provider-enforced billing caps. Re-estimate the exact approved requests before any later paid retrieval.
